claims.evidence: The witness identified the item as a 32-key melodica, which is a wind instrument, not a standard electronic keyboard.
Budget suitability is subjective and depends on the buyer's specific financial constraints.

risks.risk: Internal reeds may be out of tune or corroded.
risks.proof: A video clip of every key being played to hear the pitch and clarity.
risks.if_unproven: as out of tune or requiring reed replacement

risks.risk: Sanitary condition of the mouthpiece and flexible tube.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the interior of the mouthpiece and tube connectors.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring the purchase of new accessories

risks.risk: Specific model value (e.g., P-32D vs P-32E).
risks.proof: A photo of the model number printed on the back of the instrument.

risks.risk: Adhesive damage or staining from key stickers.
risks.proof: Photo of the keys with stickers removed or a high-resolution close-up of the key surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: as having permanent surface staining on keys

proof_requests: Video of all 32 keys being played individually.
Photo of the model number on the back of the melodica.
Photo showing the contents of the light blue case seen in Photo 2.
Close-up of the mouthpiece and tube interior.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the item as a Yamaha 32-key melodica. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (out of tune, scuffed, and requiring new accessories).
